lines.text: Many learners say: I want to join to the English club.
Better: I want to join the English club.
Join takes the group directly, with no to.
Join! Please join us for dinner.

data.wrong: I want to join to the English club.
data.right: I want to join the English club.
data.why: Join takes the group directly, with no to.
